fills.name: Bee Skep Production
fills.quote: +8 (gold popup over the same Longhouse at game 19:04 in s_00976 and 19:14 in s_00986); BEE SKEP PRODUCTION | Bee Skeps Gold generation timer. | 9 (s_00833, 15:59)
fills.note: Seconds per gold tick. The camera is static from game 19:01 to 19:17. At 10 fps the '+8' popup first appears at video 975.6, 985.9 and 996.1, so about 10.2-10.3 game seconds apart (game clock runs 1:1 with video there). The hovered timer reads 10 at 15:58 and 9 at 15:59; the 10 is in a sub-second re-extract at scratchpad nd/f_832.6.jpg. So the timer is 10 s, not 9.6. 8 gold per 10 s is 48 gold/min, against the tooltip's 'Generates 50 Gold per minute'.
fills.tieReason: s_00986 shows '+8' gold popups over two Longhouses at 19:13-19:14. In s_00833 '+8' gold popups appear the moment 'Bee Skeps completed' shows, with the Longhouse at 8/min. 8 gold per cycle of about 9.6 s gives the stated 50 gold/min. ReaderA's 10 is the popup spacing, which is the interval rather than the amount and is not exact; the tooltip countdown showed 9. Following the project convention (effectValue = amount, interval = time), the answer is 8.
